matching: Exact slot plus unordered triangle/corner positions cast to imported float32 then rounded to1e-4cm after original OBJ (x,-y,z) reflection; no UV matching
hash_encoding: Canonical positions/topology/UV/non-cabin frames: ordered element IDs, little-endian int32/float32 and length-prefixed UTF8 strings; all-attributes digest: same-process UE5.8 MeshDescription serialization; SHA1

normal_source_provenance.uv_policy: Not repaired, reimported, or edited; the UE builder must duplicate the existing mesh attributes

render_comparison_scope: LOD0 CPU index corners: exact position/UE-UV/material/winding and decoded packed tangent X/Z/W float bits; duplicate faces are multisets. Not shader output, vertex-color-buffer, GPU pixel, lighting, collision or performance equivalence.
cabin_tangent_policy: Cabin only: project original computed tangent X onto GLB normal; if parallel, project original signed cross(N,X) binormal; if both collapse, use normal.FindBestAxisVectors. These projected/reconstructed rendering tangents are not GLB-authored tangents or repaired UV data. Source binormal sign is retained.
frame_bake_provenance: Derived MD only: normal/tangent/binormal-sign frames baked from original cached computed LOD0 render corners. Exact material/triangle positions/cyclic winding and inherited UE UVs quantized to actual packing disambiguate corners; generated lightmap UV channel is excluded only from correspondence. Cabin normals then come from GLB and cabin tangents project or reconstruct the computed source basis, with explicit binormal/axis fallback counts. Outside the cabin, only demonstrably zero/collinear computed source tangents are reconstructed across affected slots; their normals and signs are retained and all other source tangents remain baked. Unrendered exact-zero-area unused frames remain original. No source rebuild or source MD mutation.
source_degenerate_tangent_repair_policy: Derived only, outside the1237 GLB cabin triangles: any source material slot, but only demonstrably zero/parallel computed source X against finite nonzero N. Construct normal.FindBestAxisVectors tangent; retain exact source decoded normal and binormal sign. No valid source tangents, source normals, UVs or source assets are repaired or waived; affected material slots are listed explicitly.

non_cabin_render_quantization_delta.matching: Exact material/position/UE-UV/cyclic-winding groups; duplicate frame multisets require a perfect bipartite match within one actual packed-component step plus float epsilon; tangent X.W and normal/sign Z.W remain bit-exact.
non_cabin_render_quantization_delta.source_degenerate_tangent_exception: Only demonstrably source-degenerate frames: source X zero/parallel to finite nonzero N, across any original material slot (relative cross squared <=1e-12). Derived packed X/N must be finite unit/orthogonal within packing error; normal delta still one component step and both W/sign values exact. Every valid source tangent retains the component-delta limit; no normal or W/sign exception is permitted.
